raw_text: Niger's military junta, the CNSP, has consolidated power after detaining President Mohamed Bazoum in what appears to be a well-planned coup. General Abdourahamane Tchiani has declared himself head of state. The African Union and ECOWAS have condemned the takeover and suspended Niger's membership. France has demanded the restoration of constitutional order. The UN Secretary-General has called for Bazoum's immediate release. Analysts warn the coup could destabilise the broader Sahel region and affect counter-terrorism operations against jihadist groups.
